bays.restriction: On-street pay-and-display bays — Parking Management Scheme (Longford)
bays.times: Pay-and-display operating hours are usually 08:00–18:30 Mon–Sat but vary by scheme — check the machine label and time plate. Outside operating hours, and on Sundays and bank holidays, parking in pay-and-display bays is free (council charges page)
bays.tariff: Up to 30 mins: resident Free / non-resident £1.30; 30 mins–1 hr: £1.50 / £2.50; up to 1.5 hrs: £2.40 / £4.00; up to 2 hrs: £3.30 / £5.50; then per 30 mins after 2 hours to the maximum stay: 80p / £1.40. Maximum stays vary from 30 minutes to 8 hours by street. (first figure HillingdonFirst resident rate, second non-resident)
bays.pay: Pay-and-display machine (card or coins 5p–£2). HillingdonFirst cardholders pay the resident rates and get 30 minutes free at most machines
